notes: These runs used the same Nemotron models through NVIDIA's API catalog (build.nvidia.com), keeping the Token Factory credit for the live demo. There our account had no Nemotron 3 Nano, so pointing-phrase classification ran on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. Costs are priced at Token Factory list prices.
Talk-over uses the speech intervals from NVIDIA Parakeet for both systems; descriptions are timed at 2.5 words per second.
Coverage labels were written by the builder after viewing the frames at each pointing moment; Nemotron 3 Ultra judges them.

Held-out clips were labelled blind and never used to tune Unsaid's prompts, and their labels include pointing moments the phrase detector misses. Unsaid ran on them once before a change to where paused descriptions start, a change that development failures also called for. Development clips were also used to develop the prompts. No phrase from any clip appears in a prompt.

The same Super VL verifier checks both systems' descriptions against the frames; descriptions it could not check are excluded from that rate and counted separately. Unsaid's own check-and-correct step answers to this verifier, so this rate favours Unsaid; invented numbers and names are counted by code instead.
Every clip was described 2 times, because model outputs vary from run to run; the metrics pool all runs, and per_run shows each run on its own.
